about: Email addresses that may appear in this PUBLIC repository, each reviewed. Checked by .github/scripts/check_public_correspondence.py (C3). Only a supplier's published or supplier-authorised BUSINESS contact, a service identity or a synthetic test fixture may be listed; personal webmail addresses can never be listed, and supplier correspondence never belongs here. PlotNua's own addresses (plotnua.ie, plotart.ie) and reserved test domains (example.com, *.test, *.invalid, *.example) need no entry. An entry whose address no longer appears in the repository fails the check until it is removed.
